mapper.select: SELECT c.club_number, c.status, f.festival_number, f.festival_name, c.club_name, c.purpose, a.account_number, a.nickname, c.created_at FROM clubs c JOIN festivals f ON f.FESTIVAL_NUMBER = c.FESTIVAL_NUMBER JOIN attendees atd ON atd.CLUB_NUMBER = c.CLUB_NUMBER AND atd.attendee_role = 0 JOIN accounts a ON a.ACCOUNT_NUMBER = atd.ACCOUNT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.CLUB_NUMBER DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset};
